verifiedControls: Valid Unix-second provider timestamps are converted to ISO timestamps.
Absent, malformed, unsafe, or out-of-range timestamps become null and use existing database-time fallback behavior.
Invalid timestamp values cannot throw during durable receipt processing and defer an otherwise valid webhook event.
